newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Outokumpu 96 profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Outokumpu 96 profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 298 million markka median forecast for Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 16 analysts, EPS by 14 analysts)
Outokumpu's results are due on February 24 at 1000/0800 GMT.
In 1995, Outokumpu had a 1.48 billion markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 16 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 1.15 billion markka (mean 1.10 billion) in an 821 million to 1.26 billion markka range.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities, Paribas and Postipankki.
